title: Area Manager - Micra Specialist (Leadless Pacemaker)
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Micra Specialist- Working around focus product in East with key customer in alignment with sales for Micra therapy adoption and skill building.

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) business delivers therapies that help manage heart rhythm disorders through implantable pacing and cardiac monitoring technologies. This role supports the expansion of leadless pacing therapy, partnering with physicians, hospitals, and healthcare systems to increase adoption and improve patient access to advanced cardiac care.

This position covers East India and Chhattisgarh and requires management of a large, multi-state territory. The role is field-based with extensive customer engagement across hospitals, cardiac centers, and healthcare institutions. Travel is expected up to 60% of the time.

**Job Description field**

The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales growth, market development, and therapy adoption across the assigned territory. The role works closely with Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, hospital stakeholders, distributors, and key opinion leaders to expand access to Cardiac Rhythm Management therapies while achieving business objectives.

  
  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Drive sales performance and achieve annual operating plan targets across the assigned territory.
* Build and strengthen relationships with Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, hospital administrators, and other healthcare stakeholders.
* Develop and execute territory plans to increase adoption of leadless pacing and Cardiac Rhythm Management therapies.
* Identify new business opportunities, assess customer needs, and deliver appropriate product and therapy solutions.
* Manage key accounts, key opinion leaders, and distributor partnerships to support sustainable business growth.
* Analyze market trends, competitive activity, customer dynamics, and account potential to prioritize opportunities.
* Lead physician education, therapy awareness, and market development initiatives to expand therapy penetration.
Maintain accurate sales reporting, customer records, and completion of required compliance and product training.  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience\*
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience\*
OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience\*  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Cardiac Rhythm Management devices, Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI), Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR), or Impella therapies.
* Experience managing corporate and government healthcare accounts.
* IBHRE Certified Cardiac Device Specialist (CCDS) certification.
* Understanding of electrophysiology procedures, pacing therapies, and catheterization laboratory environments.
Experience leading therapy adoption and market development initiatives within cardiology.  

**Physical Job Requirements**  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

description:

**About the role**
------------------

As a Senior Manager Contract Management Services you are responsible for the teams entrusted by the CPS Market Unit to oversee and optimise the financial aspects of the Contracts they agree with our customers, you will provide direction and leadership to your team of professionals to ensure that Contract costs are controlled, revenue is maximised and all key contractual obligations are met.

  

Your team will support Market Unit customer facing Contract Managers to prep for contract negotiations and management, reviewing contracts to ensure favourable terms and conditions which align with our financial goals, including assessing risks, identifying cost saving opportunities and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

  

You will implement processes and controls within your team to monitor and manage costs associated with CPS contracts, leading a team of professionals who will analyse financial data, identify cost variances and implementation strategies to mitigate risks and optimise cost efficiency.

  

In support of customer facing Market Unit contract managers, you will develop strategies to optimise revenue generation from contracts, including pricing optimisation, revenue recognition and contract performance analysis. Your teams will undertake financial analysis and reporting to assess financial impact of contracts, track revenue and cost trends, they will identify and mitigate financial risks such as financial fluctuations, contract disputes or non-compliance by implementing risk assessment frameworks, developing contingency plans and ensuring adherence to internal controls and regulatory requirements.

  

You will drive strong stakeholder management/ partnership capability within your team, delivering professional and effective stakeholder relationships with legal, finance, sales and operations team to ensure alignment and effective communication regarding contract terms, financial implications and performance metrics.

You will collaborate with Service Control colleagues to ensure that ITIL framework principles are deployed across your team and supporting ITIL capabilities available in the Managed Service space are utilised to further enhance the professionalisation of your function.

  

You will drive transformation within your function, sponsoring the design and delivery of a major transformation programme designed to optimise a strategic system driven approach to cost assurance and revenue management to optimise the service we offer at best cost and utilise our professional resources on the highest value activities within the function.

  

Overall you will play a crucial role in optimising financial outcomes related to the contracts we manage on behalf of the Market Unit customer facing contract managers, you and your teams will be seen as trusted partners of the Market Unit Contract Management teams, you will help ensure that our contracts are financially viable, costs are controlled, revenue is optimised and risks are mitigated, ultimately contributing to the CPS aorganisations financial success.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**Strategic Oversight**  
Accountable for the strategic direction, organisation, operational performance and cost-to-serve of Contract Management Services (CMS), leveraging industry best practices and strategic tooling.
  
Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer trust, satisfaction and colleague experience while delivering professional services at optimum customer value.
  
Define end-to-end CMS processes in alignment with Market Unit Contract Management partners.
  
Champion emerging industry practices and leverage ITIL principles across Service Control to continuously improve CMS capabilities.
  
**Operational & Commercial Management**  
Lead implementation of the Service Operations strategy and delivery of contractual service requirements, maximising service profitability and customer outcomes.
  
Provide SME leadership across complex, high-risk commercial opportunities, including negotiations, SLAs, contract management and P&L responsibilities.
  
Accountable for implementation of CMS governance across CPS contracts in partnership with customer-facing Contract Managers.
  
Define processes and governance, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive improvement and quality assurance plans.
  
Optimise resources, demand, capacity and cost base to support operational and commercial objectives.
  
Drive integration and transformation across CMS, working with Service Control, Design & Delivery, Procurement, Product, Finance, Legal and Market Units to improve customer experience, reduce costs, optimise revenue and maintain regulatory compliance.
  
**Quality Assurance & Performance**  
Establish and monitor quality assurance standards across CMS and matrix teams.
  
Define and track KPIs to measure operational effectiveness, efficiency and service quality.
  
Translate performance data into actionable insights that improve quality, resource allocation and business outcomes.
  
Drive governance and best practice, particularly across processes impacting cost, revenue and customer experience.
  
**Team Leadership & Development**  
Lead and develop CMS leaders and teams, creating an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance culture.
  
Coach leaders to improve performance, navigate challenges and deliver customer and operational objectives within a matrix environment.
  
Develop training and communication programmes to strengthen CMS capability and service standards.
  
Build strong partnership and stakeholder-management capabilities across the team.
  
Promote appropriate professional accreditation and continuous development to strengthen expertise.
  
**Stakeholder & Customer Management**  
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, department heads, internal partners and customers.
  
Understand business requirements and align CMS priorities with customer and organisational objectives.
  
Drive a strong understanding of customers within CMS, protecting their brand, customers and service expectations.
  
Act as the customer champion for CMS across Service Control, Managed Services and the wider business.
  
**Continuous Improvement & Crisis Management**  
Drive continuous improvement, innovation, process automation and strategic tool optimisation across CMS and matrix teams.
  
Identify, analyse and resolve complex operational issues, implementing proactive measures to maintain service continuity and improve outcomes.
  
Lead change initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, customer experience and colleague experience.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Operational Expertise:** Proficiency in ITIL principles and experience working within a Contract Management, Cost Assurance and Revenue Management environment, preferably within a global context. A good understanding of BT products and services and the e2e customer lifecycles process. Strong working knowledge of Managed Services, CPS contract tooling ecosystem. Possesses the ability to take well-evaluated risks and be audacious in making decisions and taking action.

**Customer Focus:** Ability to understand customer needs, infrastructure, brand and business objectives and foster positive relationships at a Senior level to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. Strong customer focus and drive to provide proactive, pre-emptive and best in class service.
  
**Communication Skills:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders and customers at all levels.
  
**Problem-Solving Abilities:** Proven track record of identifying root causes, analysing data, and implementing effective solutions to resolve operational issues. Demonstrable tenacity in driving improvements through matrixed teams.
  
**Change Management:** Experience managing organisational change and driving transformational initiatives to improve operational performance. Proven ability to lead teams through transformation and continuous change Clear focus on continuous improvement and uses initiatives such as upskilling, automation and process improvement on a regular basis across their area of expertise and specific processes.
  
**Leadership Standards:** Demonstrated leadership qualities, including integrity, accountability, customer-centricity, and a growth mindset.
  
**Commercial Acumen:** Understanding of commercial and financial drivers impacting service and business performance, with the ability to translate business plans into operational priorities.
  
**Team Management:** Experience leading and developing diverse teams, fostering a culture of inclusivity, high performance, and continuous improvement.
  
**Matric Management:** Experience of driving governance and engagement across matrixed teams and stakeholders, proven ability to drive Change Management across teams outside of own operational control.
  
Previous experience in managing teams of CMS professionals or similar roles within a fast-paced environment.
  
Good understanding of the Managed Service, CPS Contract strategic tooling ecosystem.
  
Good understanding of existing barriers and challenges impacting CMS.
  
Experience of sponsoring major transformation programmes
  
Proven ability to lead large teams and drive performance improvements.
  
Track record of building successful relationships with stakeholders and managing customer expectations.
  
Familiarity with digital trends and market dynamics impacting contract management, cost assurance and revenue management processes.
  
Strong financial abilities and commercial acumen.
  
A very good understanding of ITIL environments including ITIL Foundation (V4) accreditation
  
In depth knowledge of managed customer solutions and market dynamics in a service context.
  
The role holder must have significant experience in working and leading in an IT environment using ITIL framework.
  
Understanding of how effective implementation of these services will enable the business to be best in class in the industry.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

Sirion Deployment
  
Supplier Management
  
Contractual Accounting Background

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Delivery & Release Coordinator (UAT and Quality) - IFS Logistics
description:
**Company Description**

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**

**About IFS Logistics**

IFS Logistics is an AI enterprise logistics platform that helps shippers and logistics businesses connect transport data, manage carrier spend and automate execution. Originally launched as 7bridges, the product is now part of IFS and is developed by a small, dedicated team.

**The role**

We are looking for a Delivery & Release Coordinator to manage user acceptance testing, release activity and day-to-day delivery coordination across the product team.

The team is preparing for its first IFS Cloud customer go-live, bringing a new API into production and recruiting a significant number of new colleagues. As the pace of delivery increases, we need clear ownership of test cycles, defects, release readiness and communication.

You will coordinate UAT with customers and internal stakeholders, maintain release plans and checklists, track defects through to resolution and support go/no-go decisions. You will work closely with Lorraine Hassall, our Quality Manager, allowing her to focus on quality standards and strategy while you manage the practical coordination required to apply them consistently.

Most of the role is focused on UAT, releases and delivery. It also includes a smaller amount of team coordination, particularly onboarding, in-person sessions, travel planning, and financial coordination.

**What you'll work on**

**UAT and release management**

* Plan and coordinate UAT cycles with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Confirm scope, participants, test windows, evidence and sign-off for each cycle.
* Track defects from identification through triage, ownership, resolution and closure.
* Support on the release calendar, release notes, readiness checklist and go/no-go process.
* Coordinate with other teams in IFS as the product is integrated with IFS Cloud.
* Support the UAT and release plan for Project Oliver and the first IFS Cloud customer go-live.

**Supporting the quality function**

* Work with the Quality Manager on test processes, evidence and audit trails.
* Help apply standards such as clear acceptance criteria, merge-request review and controlled production releases.
* Support the move from periodic manual QA towards per-ticket quality assurance and more frequent releases.

**Delivery coordination**

* Keep Jira accurate, with current statuses, acceptance criteria and links to relevant merge requests.
* Maintain useful documentation and decision records in Notion.
* Prepare concise delivery and release updates for product and engineering leads.
* Identify risks early, clarify ownership and follow actions through to completion.

**Team coordination**

* Organise onboarding logistics for new starters and monthly in-person sessions in Staines.
* Coordinate team travel, expenses and purchase orders.

 **Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

* Strong organisation and follow-through, with a habit of identifying and addressing issues early.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* The ability to work constructively with engineers and maintain agreed standards when priorities are competing.
* A practical, accountable approach to moving work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
* Experience coordinating UAT, software releases or delivery within a product or engineering team.
* Familiarity with release notes, test cycles, defect tracking, go/no-go decisions, acceptance criteria and regression scope.
* Experience managing a defect list through triage and resolution rather than only reporting its status.
* Confidence using Jira and a documentation platform such as Notion or Confluence.

Relevant backgrounds may include delivery coordination, release coordination, junior delivery management, QA coordination, scrum mastery or project coordination. We are more interested in what you have managed than in your previous job title.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with enterprise software involving customer UAT and formal sign-off.
* Exposure to regulated or audited environments, ERP products or supply-chain software.
* ISTQB, Agile or delivery certification.
* Experience working within a large organisation with established procurement and HR processes.
* Experience using AI tools to draft release notes, summarise defect lists or prepare status updates.

**Tools**

The team uses Jira, Notion, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, along with IFS systems for travel, expenses and purchasing. You do not need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with engineers and understanding their delivery processes.

**What success looks like in the first six months**

* Releases follow a predictable cadence and include clear, accurate release notes.
* Each UAT cycle has an agreed owner, schedule, defect list, evidence and sign-off.
* Customer and support defects receive clear ownership and a visible route to resolution.
* The Project Oliver go-live is supported by a well-managed UAT and release plan.
* Acceptance criteria, review and release controls are applied consistently.
* Product and engineering leads spend less time on routine coordination and administration.

**Why we're hiring now**

The product team is growing and preparing for several important releases. The Quality Manager currently carries much of the practical coordination associated with testing and releases. This role will provide dedicated support of that work, helping the team increase delivery frequency while maintaining clear quality and release controls.

 **Additional Information**

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

title: Sr Service Support Coordinator
description:
Overview:

Join a dynamic and customer-focused service organization where you will play a critical role in ensuring seamless coordination of field service activities and delivering an exceptional customer experience. As a Service Coordinator, you will work closely with customers, field engineers, and cross-functional teams to manage service operations, drive efficiency, and support the successful execution of service commitments. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your organizational skills, problem-solving mindset, and ability to build strong relationships will directly contribute to customer success and operational excellence.

  
Responsibilities:

* Monitor service orders from initiation through completion, proactively identifying and resolving scheduling, logistics, or operational issues to minimize delays and improve service performance.
* Collaborate with field engineers, service managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure efficient execution of service commitments and adherence to operational processes.
* Maintain accurate service records, documentation, and system updates, ensuring data integrity and providing visibility into service performance.
* Track key service metrics and generate reports to support operational reviews, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous process optimization.
* Support business objectives by ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and quality requirements while contributing to a culture of operational excellence and teamwork.

  
Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree with 3-5+ years of experience in service coordination, field service operations, customer support, scheduling or a related operational role within a service-driven organization.  
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple service requests, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
On a daily basis, Business Coaches are responsible for:  
  
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.  
  
A day in the life  
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. Together, you’ll provide best-in-class support for owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.
